feature_time_rule: Every feature column must be observable or reconstructible from information available no later than obs_date. Current validation knowledge must never be injected retroactively.
label_time_rule: Forward outcomes are labels, never features. label_available_from_H equals the horizon end market date and may be used only after that date.

research_partitions.legacy_replay_spent: obs_date <= 2026-09-25; may be used for replay, diagnostics and rule discovery but never as fresh confirmation for a Phase-7 rule selected with knowledge of this partition
research_partitions.prospective_unspent: obs_date >= 2026-09-26; reserved for genuinely future evaluation after the Phase-7B freeze
research_partitions.embargo_gap: any configured gap between the spent cutoff and prospective start; must not be silently reassigned

selection.notes: R-code is used only where actually stored. B4/B5 quality bands are not relabelled as exact historical R4/R5.

timing.notes: Pattern matches before catalog availability are replay-only/spent evidence, not claims that the pattern was known at that historical date.

probability.notes: Current Phase-2 calibrated probabilities are not copied onto older rows. Prospective typed 7A packets must archive them as-of when available.

risk.notes: Current Phase-3 validation strength is not retrojected. Missing components stay missing.

confidence.notes: Historical legacy Confidence is preserved only as a version-sensitive diagnostic. It is not renamed Confidence-vNext and does not become a reliability feature by implication.

elliott.notes: Legacy Elliott-like columns are not treated as Module-6H evidence. Genuine 6H evidence enters only through prospective typed 7A packets.

forward_labels.return: adjusted-close total-return proxy over exact trading-session horizon
forward_labels.peer_excess: return minus leave-one-symbol-out same-currency daily peer median, with validated global fallback
forward_labels.adverse_excursion: maximum entry-relative loss within the forward adjusted-price path
forward_labels.path_max_drawdown: maximum peak-to-trough drawdown within the forward adjusted-price path

dependency_rule: Overlapping forward windows remain dependent observations. Phase 7C+ must retain date-cluster/block-bootstrap logic and must not treat daily rows as iid.
